messages:
Maria C.: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: moved the June launch assets into /s3/launch-assets, updated the content calendar with final hero image. Blockers: still waiting on the final benchmark graph from Eng to include in the blog. Today: prep social copy and finalize CTA variants.

Sam L.: Thanks — can you drop the exact image path? I want to wire it into the landing A/B test.

Maria C.: Sure — s3://redwood-launch/hero/v3/hero-1200x628.png. Use that one; I compressed it with `squoosh --quality=82`.

Kevin R.: Quick heads up from eng side: PR #452 (benchmarking scripts) is in review, but I need a final thumbs from @jessica on the graph labels before merging. Won't block deploy, but the exported chart will change slightly.

Jessica H.: On it — I skimmed the draft, will update the y-axis label to 'median latency (ms)' and push a tiny styling tweak. Expect a review comment in the PR in 30–45m.

Maria C.: Awesome — if that's done today we can ship the blog with the live graph. If not, we should include a placeholder image and schedule a minor edit for after merge. Preference: ship with live graph.

Oliver (Benchmarks Bot): benchmark-runner: finished job 2026-06-11T09:12Z. New dataset uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/2026-06-11/summary.csv. Generated chart: s3://redwood-bench/2026-06-11/latency-median.png.

Kevin R.: That chart looks good at a glance. I cleaned the script to output SVG now so we can resize without quality loss — replacing the PNG in the PR in a minute.

Sam L.: Great. Logistics: does everyone agree we target blog publish Thu 11:00 PT and social push at 12:00 PT? That gives us time to QA and update the hero if needed.

Jessica H.: Thursday 11 PT works. I'll aim to have the merged PR by EOD Wed — if anything slips ping me in #eng-oncall.

Maria C.: Plan B noted. Who's on comms for the tweets? I can draft threads tonight and post in the morning for sign-off.

Sam L.: I can take primary for Twitter threads. Maria, send drafts to me and @Kevin R. for technical accuracy.

Kevin R.: Happy to review. Also, tiny ask for eng: can we get a permalink to the raw CSV so marketing can link to the data source? Oliver (Benchmarks Bot) or QA Bot can that be generated?

Oliver (Benchmarks Bot): benchmark-runner: raw CSV public url created: https://assets.redwood.ai/bench/2026-06-11/summary.csv (expires in 30 days).

Maria C.: Perfect — we'll include that as 'data source' in the blog footnote.

Sam L.: One last thing — QA: @QA Bot can you run the preflight checklist for the blog (links, image alt text, GA tags) on publish day morning?

QA Bot: QA-runner: preflight checklist scheduled for 2026-06-12T17:30Z. Will post results in this thread and tag @Maria C. and @Sam L.

Jessica H.: If PR merges late, we can still push the post and patch the image later. Not ideal but safer than missing the window.

Maria C.: Sounds good. Blockers resolved plan: Jessica to review PR -> Oliver to swap SVG into final assets -> QA-runner to preflight -> Sam to publish social at 12 PT. I'll post final checklist when QA passes. Thanks team :rocket:

Sam L.: Thanks all — ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:
